output:
**A little update from Lotus Glow Nails**

Dear friends, neighbors, church family, and all my wonderful ladies,

After 11 years on Bellaire Blvd, Lotus Glow Nails had a visitor we were not expecting! Around 2 a.m. Sunday, November 8, a lady’s car came through our front window and stopped right at a pedicure chair. Maybe she wanted a spa day! My daughter said she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston.

Thank God, nobody was inside, and the driver is OK. The police came, and her insurance will pay for the damage. The front glass is gone, one pedicure chair is smashed, and the floor looks like a rainbow threw up. My husband says the shop is finally modern art!

I did cry a little when I saw everything in the morning, but I’m OK now. God protected us because nobody was inside. Please don’t worry about me.

**Lotus Glow Nails is closed for now.** The city inspector needs to check the wall before we can open again. The contractor says we should reopen **Monday, November 16**, as long as the inspection goes well. I will let you know if anything changes.

**This week, Trang, Kim, and I are working at my cousin Hoa’s salon, Pearland Nail Bar.** To make an appointment or find us, please call or text my cell at **832-555-0147**.

And if you have a Lotus Glow Nails gift card, don’t worry—it is still good. Nobody will lose their money.

Thank you so much for all the texts, prayers, and food. And thank you to Mrs. Dung for bringing pho this morning. You all have taken such good care of me. Please feel free to share this with anyone who has been asking.

With love and gratitude,  
Your Lotus Glow Nails family
